==Flavor Text==

''Pale white across wild, endless skies, ripe with portents of storm and thunder.''

==About==

A {{i|Ghost Rider}} is the product of a third growth stage, third tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Right-clicking a Ghost Rider and selecting "Slice" will give you 6x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 15x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Ghost Rider counts as {{i|Any Large Pumpkin}}. A Ghost Rider can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
